title: The largest automorphism group of del Pezzo surface of degree $2$ without points (Theorem 1.4)
author: Anastasia V. Vikulova
work: The largest automorphism group of del Pezzo surface of degree $2$ without points
difficulty_reason: Counted unit: the article's Theorem 1.4 (source0.tex lines 129-159, printed as Theorem 1.4 on page 2), the paper's main result: the del Pezzo surface of degree 2 over Q(sqrt(-7)) cut out by w^2+(x^4+y^4+z^4)-(3/2)(1-sqrt(-7))(x^2y^2+x^2z^2+y^2z^2)=0 is smooth, has automorphism group PSL_2(F_7) x Z/2Z, Picard group Z, and no rational points. The retained complete proof (lines 415-500) is a genuine 86-line argument, not a routine verification: smoothness is settled by a direct derivative computation, the automorphism group is computed through the anticanonical double cover and an exact sequence controlling the Galois action on the ramification quartic, the Picard group is obtained from a Noether-Lefschetz type argument, and the absence of rational points requires the local analysis over Q_2 together with a reduction modulo 64 of the associated equation. The residual difficulty is that four quite different invariants of one explicitly given surface must be computed and then combined to exclude rational points; this is research-level arithmetic geometry well beyond ordinary PhD qualifying exercises.

primary.theorem: Theorem 1.4 (del Pezzo surface of degree 2 without points)
